git_rationale.root_cause_commit: dbb35f72 — feat(web): Notion UI redesign + meal pool unification + 3 bug fixes
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Prior cycle intentionally scoped to CSS token system and behavioral bugs (M2-M6). Layout restructure (AF-03) and remaining visual polish (AF-01/02/04/05/06/08) were deferred. This cycle addresses the structural L2 DOM reorganization.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Replaces Bootstrap-era 3-pane layout with user-mandated Days|Dashboard+Timeline|Candidates paradigm. Preserves all stable container IDs for drag.js and budget.js compatibility.

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: L2 structural layout reorganization requires: new HTML pane structure (~50 lines), new CSS for day-rows/tab-bar/typography/responsive (~80 lines), new JS functions renderDaysPanel/_populateMobileDaySelect/_wireMiddleTabs/_activateMiddleTab (~60 lines), plus removal of old _wireDayPicker/_renderDayPickerOptions and stale pane references. Cannot be smaller for a complete 3-pane restructure.

dev.qa_notes: QA steps: (1) open /trip/beijing-lijiang-dali-20260418-100846, verify title shows 'Beijing · Lijiang · Dali' not slug; (2) left pane shows Day 1-N with city names, active day highlighted; (3) click different days, Timeline/Candidates re-render; (4) click Dashboard tab, verify budget totals visible; (5) click Timeline tab, verify timeline-slots visible; (6) drag card from Candidates to Timeline slot; (7) at 390px viewport, verify Days panel hidden, mobile-day-select visible, mobile tabs Timeline/Candidates work; (8) M4 transport callout visible on day-03; (9) M2 single Meals group in Candidates. Known gap: codex finding #4 (mobile-day-select not CSS position:sticky) is out of scope — BA spec does not mandate sticky positioning in AC8.

codex_consult.feedback_summary: Codex ran live browser tests and found 6 issues: (1) day-row text missing separator between 'Day N' and 'CityName' spans — accessibility text reads 'Day 1Kunming'; (2) banner CSS display:flex overriding [hidden] attribute, causing hidden banners to push grid down 91px; (3) old duplicate .card-name/.slot-title rules overriding the new AF-01 typography values; (4) mobile day selector not position:sticky; (5) mobile outer 'Timeline' tab can show Dashboard content if inner tab was switched before; (6) panel border-right/left on pane-days/pane-candidates not matching 'border:none' wording in AC5 (but BA spec explicitly mandates these as separators). OBSERVATION_ONLY: mobile.js comment still says candidates|timeline|budget.
codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: Issues 1 (aria-label added to day-row buttons), 2 (banner[hidden]{display:none} added to CSS), 3 (removed duplicate .card-name/.slot-title CSS rules that overrode new values), 5 (inner Timeline tab reset when outer mobile tab switches to middle). Issue 4 (sticky) is out of scope — BA spec does not mandate position:sticky in any AC. Issue 6 (border-right/left) is out of scope — BA spec CSS section explicitly mandates 'pane-days: border-right: 1px solid var(--border)' and 'pane-candidates: border-left: 1px solid var(--border)' as separators; AC5 'border:none' refers to the old full box-border, not these single-side separators.

self_verification.notes: Codex performed live Playwright browser test confirming page loads at http://127.0.0.1:8876/trip/beijing-lijiang-dali-20260418-100846. Grid renders at expected height. #timeline-slots and #candidates-groups present as stable mounted containers. All critical IDs verified present in new HTML. No bare h2/h3 CSS rules confirmed by grep. Post-codex fixes applied: banner[hidden] display:none, duplicate CSS rules removed, aria-label added to day-rows, mobile inner tab reset.
